rules.statement: The owner of an undivided share of a land may, in support of his claim to such share, call evidence to show that he had taken the produce of a certain number of trees in the garden.
rules.supporting_quote: It is quite competent for the owners of undivided shares to make arrangements among themselves as to the enjoyment of the produce of the land, and evidence showing that the plaintiff had enjoyed the fruit of these trees would go to support his title to 5/16 .
